periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertically oriented with a slight medial tilt toward the snout at the inferior margin.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, visual height is approximately double the visual width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lower half narrower than the upper half, shifting the visual center upward.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering the entire shoulder girdle and upper-third of the visible torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, estimated at 2.5 to 3 times the width of a single pinna region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular with smooth, rounded apex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown discoloration on the ventral and lower torso fur; oral cavity is open exposing maxillary and mandibular dentition.
